name: educaplay
description: Create, edit and publish Educaplay educational games and quizzes.

interface.longDescription:
Educaplay is a platform where teachers create interactive learning activities and share them with their students. With Educaplay in ChatGPT you can turn a topic, a text or your own notes into a ready-to-play activity without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Create activities of 19 types: Quiz, Video Quiz, Crossword Puzzle, Word Search Puzzle, Fill in the Blanks, Matching, Matching Pairs, Memory, Riddle, Alphabet, Unscramble Letters, Unscramble Words, Line Up, Yes or No, Froggy Jumps, AsterQuiz, Dictation, Dialogue and Slideshow.
- Write and edit their content: questions and answers, words and clues, pairs, texts and dialogues.
- Illustrate them with pictures from your Educaplay media library or from a stock photo library, attach a YouTube video to a video quiz and generate the spoken audio of dictations and dialogues.
- Set the language, age and subject, adjust the game settings and choose who can see each activity.
- Review your existing activities and publish them, so that your students can play them from a link or through Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams and LMS platforms.

Who it is for
Teachers, trainers and content creators who use Educaplay.

Requirements and limitations
You sign in with your own Educaplay account, which must include access to external applications. The plugin only works with the activities of the signed-in account. New activities stay unpublished until you ask to publish them. Uploading your own files, deleting or duplicating activities and organizing folders are done on the Educaplay website.
capabilities: Write and edit questions, words, clues and texts
Add pictures, YouTube videos and spoken audio
Set the audience, game settings and visibility
List, review and publish your activities
defaultPrompt: Create a 10-question quiz about the water cycle for 10-year-olds
Turn this text into a crossword for my students

positive.description: Lists the activities of the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the activities of the account with their title, type, whether each one is published and its link.

positive.description: Creates a quiz about a topic
positive.prompt: Create an Educaplay quiz with 5 multiple-choice questions about the solar system for 10-year-olds.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new unpublished Quiz with 5 questions in the account and returns its title and the links to edit and play it.

positive.description: Creates a crossword from words given by the user
positive.prompt: Make an Educaplay crossword with these words and clues: evaporation - water turns into vapour; condensation - vapour turns into droplets; precipitation - water falls from the clouds; collection - water gathers in oceans and lakes.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new unpublished Crossword Puzzle with the four words and their clues and returns its links.

positive.description: Illustrates the questions of an existing activity
positive.prompt: Add a picture to each question of my water cycle quiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the water cycle quiz that is already in the account, adds a photo from the photo library to each question that does not have one yet and reports which questions got an image.

positive.prompt: Publish my water cycle quiz so my students can play it.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the water cycle quiz, or confirms that it is already published, and returns the link to play it. If something blocks publishing, it explains what is missing instead.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to Educaplay: no Educaplay tool should run.
negative.prompt: What is the boiling point of water at sea level?

negative.description: Deleting activities is not available in the plugin: no tool should delete or change anything, and ChatGPT should explain that activities are deleted on the Educaplay website.
Translation request unrelated to Educaplay: no Educaplay tool should run.
negative.prompt: Translate into French: The water cycle has four stages.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything. Users sign in with an existing Educaplay account.
